d4153be plus ReSTIR sequence-ensemble decomposition; Release; 2026-10-16

notes.quality: First observed checkpoint at/below target that stays below through the final checkpoint. No interpolation; no claim beyond the measured horizon.
notes.reference: Budgets use each scene's error_reference. Finite-spp NEE/MIS noise is retained, with split discrepancies reported separately; repeated references share seeds.
notes.replication: Populations are across separate invocations. Frames within a reused sequence are correlated. Shared references are not independent replications.
notes.temporal_residuals: Run/sequence populations retain undefined zero-variance correlations as null. Centering removes persistent error, which remains in sequence_mean_rmse. Motion and finite references affect interpretation; no effective sample count is inferred.
notes.sequence_ensemble: Static only. Inflation compares across-sequence variance of sequence means with within-sequence frame variance; noise-normalized MSE compares the grand mean error with its expected noise, including finite-reference noise. Values near one are consistent with uncorrelated frames and with no detectable bias respectively; neither is a confidence bound.
notes.missing: Unreached budgets or unavailable GPU timestamps are null. Aggregate times/ratios require every run; no successful-subset averages.
notes.timing: Scene GPU time includes reservoir/metadata passes and excludes updates/readback. Dynamic clocks and validation limit inference.
notes.moving: Moving poses have no convergence budget. Finite ensemble and tile errors do not establish bias bounds.
